response.sql: WITH name_totals AS (SELECT ra.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM results res JOIN races ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), avg_t AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_points FROM name_totals), above AS (SELECT nt.name, nt.total_points FROM name_totals nt, avg_t WHERE nt.total_points > avg_t.avg_points) SELECT SUM(a.total_points) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(r2.laps AS REAL)) FROM results r2 JOIN races ra2 ON r2.raceId = ra2.raceId WHERE ra2.name IN (SELECT name FROM above)) AS avg_laps, AVG(a.total_points - avg_t.avg_points) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above a, avg_t;
